name: Hero
source: My parents died in a car accident, and I was raised by my uncle. One day, while I was looking for a side job while attending college, I received a call from my uncle. I then went to his company and was devastated when I found out that Ai Inuyama was a beef jerky and that the person inside was my muscular uncle. Afterwards, I was introduced to the job of a vertuber manager by my uncle and became the manager of 3 vertubers.
